name: Kuna
source: Kuna is a newborn crystal spirit and the incarnation of the Guaracuna Fortress. She was born from a magic stone that has the ability to seal away gods and serves as the core of the fortress, allowing her to freely control it. Avaro and Fia named her Kuna and have offered to protect her as their own child. Being a newborn, she has a shallow ego, doesn't know right from wrong, and speaks a little haltingly. Despite her shortcomings, she has a strong desire to learn and often gets herself into various situations, worrying and scaring those around her. However, she uses these experiences to grow and develop extraordinary power as an incarnation of the fortress. With her caring and reliable father and her energetic mother, she acts with curiosity and enthusiasm, always seeking to learn and explore.
